description: 원자력안전위원회_국내원전 내진설계 기준 현황 [nuclear facilities] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 원자력안전위원회. 본 데이터는 2019년 12월말 기준의 국내원전의 각 호기별 내진설계 기준 현황을 제공하는 데이터입니다. 본 데이터는 원전 운영기관, 안전 규제기관, 연구기관 등 다양한 이해관계자가 활용할 수 있으며, 내진 보강 계획 수립, 안전성 평가, 재난 대응 전략 마련 등 정책적·기술적 의사결정의 기초자료로 활용... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 원자력안전위원회. Its tags are 원자력, 발전소, 호기별, 내진설계, 기준. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
